newsitem.title: LATVIA: DAUGAVPILS CHAIN APPROVES BONUS ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: DAUGAVPILS CHAIN APPROVES BONUS ISSUE.

text.p: Daugavpils Chain maker's shareholder meeting Wednesday approved an issue of shares, whereby each shareholder will get 84 bonus shares per 100 held, meaning a capital rise of 3.2 million lats, shareholders said.
The registration date of those wanting to receive new shares is May 30.
The shareholder meeting also agreed to include a privatised workshop, worth 44,000 lats, into Daugavpils Chain basic capital.
"The workshop for the time being is going to be used as a warehouse," Roberts Misans, company board member, told Reuters.
